description: Summarize backlink authority, referring domains, spam risk, broken backlinks, and next SEO actions for a domain, subdomain, or URL. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

backlinks_status_type.description: Backlink lifecycle filter: live links only, lost links only, or all supported links. Type: String. Accepted values: "live", "all", "lost". Default: "live".

dofollow_only.description: Restrict results to followed backlinks when true; false does not apply that filter. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

exclude_internal_backlinks.description: Exclude links originating within the target’s own site when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_indirect_links.description: Include backlinks that reach the target through supported indirect/redirect link relationships when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_subdomains.description: Include links or ranking data for subdomains of the target when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

internal_list_limit.description: Maximum embedded sample rows per aggregate record; this does not cap the aggregate backlink totals. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 10.

rank_scale.description: Requested provider authority-score scale: one_hundred is 0-100; one_thousand is 0-1000. Individual filter input bounds still apply. Type: String. Accepted values: "one_hundred", "one_thousand". Default: "one_hundred".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_backlinks_summary
title: AgentSEO Backlinks Summary
